articles.title: Trump's Big Choice: Deal or 'Annihilate' Iran?
articles.summary: At the UN, President Trump said he could 'annihilate' Iran if no peace deal is reached. But on the same day, US and Iranian officials actually met through a mediator. Trump thinks a deal could come after November's elections.

articles.title: Ukraine's Zelenskyy Wants an 'Energy Truce' — No More Striking Power Plants
articles.summary: Ukraine's President Zelenskyy says he's ready to stop attacking Russian oil refineries if Russia stops hitting Ukraine's power and heating systems. He met with Trump for 40 minutes in New York. Winter is coming, and both sides are trading heavy strikes.

articles.title: One Broken Cable, Hundreds of Flights Cancelled: America's Air Traffic System Is 40 Years Old
articles.summary: A broken communications cable in Philadelphia stopped hundreds of flights across the Northeast on Monday. The backup line had been accidentally cut by railroad workers. Officials say the system is 40 years old and needs a $20 billion fix.
